# mnml-cms

> A small schema-driven CMS that lives inside your Next.js site.

Every page as one file: https://mnml-cms.vercel.app/llms-full.txt

## Docs

- [mnml-cms](https://mnml-cms.vercel.app): A small schema-driven CMS that lives inside your Next.js site.
- [Getting started](https://mnml-cms.vercel.app/getting-started): Install mnml-cms in a Next.js site: the config, createCms, the admin and API routes, the proxy and the database table.
- [Field types](https://mnml-cms.vercel.app/fields): Every field type in mnml.config.ts, its options and the value readers return.
- [Limits](https://mnml-cms.vercel.app/fields/limits): min and max on array, blocks and references fields.
- [Blocks](https://mnml-cms.vercel.app/fields/blocks): Pages made of different kinds of sections with fields.blocks() and block().
- [Select labels](https://mnml-cms.vercel.app/fields/select-labels): Show labels in the admin for select values, and read them with selectLabel().
- [Dates and times](https://mnml-cms.vercel.app/fields/dates-and-times): The date and datetime fields: storage, time zones and sorting.
- [Focal point](https://mnml-cms.vercel.app/fields/focal-point): Keep the important part of an image in frame when it's cropped (focalX, focalY, focalPosition).
- [Default values](https://mnml-cms.vercel.app/fields/default-values): Starting values for new entries, items and blocks with default.
- [Conditional fields](https://mnml-cms.vercel.app/fields/conditional-fields): Show a field only when other fields match, with showIf.
- [Derived values](https://mnml-cms.vercel.app/fields/derived-values): Read-only values computed from an entry's fields (derive, readingTime, plainText).
- [SEO](https://mnml-cms.vercel.app/fields/seo): The seo() field and seoMetadata() for Next.js metadata.
- [Reading content](https://mnml-cms.vercel.app/reading-content): Read content on your pages: getSingleton, listEntries, getEntry, getEntries, listSlugs, RichText and live preview.
- [Drafts and publishing](https://mnml-cms.vercel.app/drafts-and-publishing): Drafts, autosave, Publish, Discard changes and Unpublish, and what the site shows for each.
- [Moving content between databases](https://mnml-cms.vercel.app/moving-content): Export and import content between databases, rehost images and convert Markdown, with @n3wtou/mnml-cms/sync.
- [Extending the editor](https://mnml-cms.vercel.app/editor): Extend the rich text editor with Tiptap extensions and toolbar tools (defineEditor, editorProvider).
- [Tables](https://mnml-cms.vercel.app/editor/tables): Tables in rich text with @n3wtou/mnml-cms/table.
- [Nodes with a form](https://mnml-cms.vercel.app/editor/nodes-with-a-form): Custom rich text nodes edited through a form (tools.node, nodeAttributes).
- [Linking entries from rich text](https://mnml-cms.vercel.app/editor/linking-entries): Link to other entries from rich text with the reference tool and referenceNode.
- [Custom node rendering](https://mnml-cms.vercel.app/editor/custom-rendering): Render rich text nodes with your own React components on the site.
- [Agents (MCP)](https://mnml-cms.vercel.app/agents): Let AI agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Zed) manage content through the built-in MCP server, with scoped tokens, drafts and editor approval.
- [Options](https://mnml-cms.vercel.app/options): Every option of createCms: storage, auth, media, paths, sidebar, editor, MCP, revalidate and onChange.
- [Authentication](https://mnml-cms.vercel.app/authentication): The built-in password login, or your own auth (Better Auth, Auth.js, Clerk) through an AuthAdapter.
- [Image storage](https://mnml-cms.vercel.app/image-storage): Where uploaded images are stored: local disk in development, Vercel Blob, or your own storage.
- [Other ORMs](https://mnml-cms.vercel.app/other-orms): Store entries without Drizzle by writing your own EntryStorage (Prisma, Kysely, SQL).
- [Entry points](https://mnml-cms.vercel.app/entry-points): Every import path of @n3wtou/mnml-cms and what it contains.
- [Common mistakes](https://mnml-cms.vercel.app/common-mistakes): The mistakes that cost the most time with mnml-cms, and how to avoid them.
- [Upgrading](https://mnml-cms.vercel.app/upgrading): What each mnml-cms version added, what broke, and the steps to upgrade an older site.
